title: SAP Fiori Implementation Information
raw_text:
9/29/26, 10:15 AM

e Under Creditworthiness Records, you can enter (create) a creditworthiness record manually. These manual entries you can
reverse. The system determines the new creditworthiness automatically.

Change documents record any entries or changes that you have made to the manual creditworthiness, as well as changes to the

percentage creditworthiness factor. If there is no data record for the current calendar year, the system automatically creates an
initial record. The initial record contains the current calendar year. All other values in the creditworthiness record are blank.

SAP Fiori Implementation Information

In the SAP Fiori Apps Reference Library, see the details for the Manage Creditworthiness app.
